concerns.text: US-3 narrative requires 'Repeated 5-Fold Cross-Validation', but FR-005 and FR-006 specify plain '5-fold Cross-Validation' (no repetition count), and US-3 acceptance scenario 3 also says 'using 5-fold Cross-Validation'. Pick one term (repeated vs single 5-fold) and use it consistently; the FRs as written do not mandate the repetition the story promises.

US-2 narrative says descriptors 'OR Isometric Log-Ratio (ILR) transformed features' (either/or), while FR-003.1 mandates ILR features 'used in COMPLEMENT with the scalar descriptors'. The story's disjunctive framing contradicts the FR's conjunctive requirement; align the story wording with FR-003.1.
Typo: 'bootstrap resamples.; the standard deviation' — stray period/semicolon. Cosmetic only.
